[EN] I did something terrible, . Something I may never be able to fully atone for.

During my time with the Free Brotherhood, I created horrible weapons. I never suspected they'd be used against us, but I suppose that's no excuse."So what would you like me to do?"
[ES] Cometí algo terrible, . Algo de lo que quizás nunca pueda redimirmi por completo.

Durante mi tiempo en la Free Brotherhood, creé armas horribles. Nunca sospeché que las usarían en nuestra contra, pero supongo que eso no es excusa."So what would you like me to do?"

[EN] I can't go on knowing that those weapons are still out there. Please, go collect them for me.

Round them up, bring them back, and I'll see to it that they're destroyed. They won't take any more innocent lives.
[ES] No puedo seguir adelante sabiendo que esas armas siguen ahí fuera. Por favor, ve a recogerlas por mí.

Reúnelas, tráelas de vuelta y me encargaré de que sean destruidas. No se cobrarán más vidas inocentes.

[EN] Thank you. I'll destroy them right away, and on my life, I'll never make anything like this again.
[ES] Gracias. Las destruiré de inmediato y, por mi vida, juro que nunca volveré a fabricar algo así.

[EN] Please—you have to find those weapons before more people get hurt!
[ES] Por favor, ¡tienes que encontrar esas armas antes de que más gente salga herida!
